name: Adaptive SDF Ray Marching with Variable Step Size
definition: Generates a synthetic depth map by marching a ray through a trilinearly interpolated signed distance function volume until the zero-crossing is found, used for real-time camera tracking by comparing against incoming RGBD frames.
summary: Adaptive SDF Ray Marching generates depth maps by adjusting step size based on local SDF values to optimize sampling efficiency while finding zero-crossing surfaces.
